overview.description: The Columbia Research Enhanced Small Cap ETF (RESM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital appreciation through investments in US small-cap companies. Stock selection uses a rules-based, proprietary industry-specific quantitative framework. RESM was launched on Dec 11, 2025 and is issued by Columbia Threadneedle.
